license_required.quote: A person may not practice medicine, podiatry, or osteopathy in the state unless the person is licensed under this chapter

umbrella_agency.value: Department of Commerce, Community, and Economic Development
umbrella_agency.quote: "department" means the Department of Commerce, Community, and Economic Development

degree_required.value: Certificate of graduation from a legally chartered medical school accredited by the Association of American Medical Colleges and the Council on Medical Education of the American Medical Association
degree_required.quote: submit a certificate of graduation from a legally chartered medical school accredited by the Association of American Medical Colleges and the Council on Medical Education of the American Medical Association

accrediting_body.value: Association of American Medical Colleges and the Council on Medical Education of the American Medical Association
accrediting_body.quote: accredited by the Association of American Medical Colleges and the Council on Medical Education of the American Medical Association

required.quote: submit a certificate from a recognized hospital or hospitals certifying that the applicant has satisfactorily performed the duties of resident physician or intern

duration.value: two years (for graduates on or after January 1, 1995); one year (for graduates before January 1, 1995)
duration.quote: two years if the applicant graduated from medical school on or after January 1, 1995

kind.quote: satisfactorily performed the duties of resident physician or intern

exams.name: Board examination in subjects the board considers necessary
exams.notes: May be waived for license by credentials under AS 08.64.250
exams.quote: An applicant shall take examinations in subjects the board considers necessary, unless excused under provisions of AS 08.64.250.

interval_years.quote: the fee for a permit issued under this section is one-fourth of the fee for a biennial license

required.quote: requiring every licensee of medicine, osteopathy, and podiatry in the state to fulfill continuing education requirements

period_years.quote: not less than two hours of education in pain management and opioid use and addiction in the two years preceding an application for renewal of a license

value: pain management and opioid use and addiction (minimum 2 hours per renewal period)
topical_requirements.quote: Continuing education requirements must include not less than two hours of education in pain management and opioid use and addiction in the two years preceding an application for renewal of a license

available.quote: The board may waive the examination requirement and license by credentials if the physician, osteopath, or podiatry applicant meets the requirements of AS 08.64.200, 08.64.205, or 08.64.209, submits proof of continued competence as required by regulation, pays the required fee, and has an active license from a board of medical examiners established under the laws of a state or territory of the United States or a province or territory of Canada issued after thorough examination

requirements.value: Applicant must meet standard qualifications, submit proof of continued competence, pay required fee, and hold an active license from another U.S. state/territory or Canadian province/territory issued after thorough examination, or have passed an examination specified by the board.
requirements.quote: the board may waive the examination requirement and license by credentials if the physician, osteopath, or podiatry applicant meets the requirements of AS 08.64.200, 08.64.205, or 08.64.209, submits proof of continued competence as required by regulation, pays the required fee

regulatory_model.quote: a person practicing medicine or osteopathy in the state without a valid license or permit is guilty of a class A misdemeanor

credential_type.quote: the board or its executive secretary shall grant a license to the applicant to practice medicine in the state

is_mandatory.quote: A person may not practice medicine, podiatry, or osteopathy in the state unless the person is licensed under this chapter

title_protection.quote: to use or publicly display a title in connection with a person's name including "doctor of medicine," "physician," "M.D.," or "doctor of osteopathic medicine" or "D.O." or a specialist designation including "surgeon," "dermatologist," or a similar title in such a manner as to show that the person is willing or qualified to diagnose or treat the sick or injured

scope_protection.quote: a person practicing medicine or osteopathy in the state without a valid license or permit is guilty of a class A misdemeanor

disciplinary_grounds.quote: secured a license through deceit, fraud, or intentional misrepresentation

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaged in deceit, fraud, or intentional misrepresentation while providing professional services or engaging in professional activities
disciplinary_grounds.quote: engaged in deceit, fraud, or intentional misrepresentation while providing professional services or engaging in professional activities

disciplinary_grounds.description: Advertised professional services in a false or misleading manner
disciplinary_grounds.quote: advertised professional services in a false or misleading manner

disciplinary_grounds.description: Convicted of a class A or unclassified felony, a related class B or C felony, or a crime involving unlawful procurement, sale, prescription, or dispensing of drugs
disciplinary_grounds.quote: has been convicted, including conviction based on a guilty plea or plea of nolo contendere, of (A) a class A or unclassified felony

disciplinary_grounds.description: Procured, sold, prescribed, or dispensed drugs in violation of law regardless of criminal action or patient harm
disciplinary_grounds.quote: has procured, sold, prescribed, or dispensed drugs in violation of a law regardless of whether there has been a criminal action or harm to the patient

disciplinary_grounds.description: Intentionally or negligently permitted patient care by supervised persons that does not conform to minimum professional standards
disciplinary_grounds.quote: intentionally or negligently permitted the performance of patient care by persons under the licensee's supervision that does not conform to minimum professional standards even if the patient was not injured

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failed to comply with the chapter, a regulation adopted under it, or an order of the board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: failed to comply with this chapter, a regulation adopted under this chapter, or an order of the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Demonstrated professional incompetence, gross negligence, or repeated negligent conduct
disciplinary_grounds.quote: professional incompetence, gross negligence, or repeated negligent conduct

disciplinary_grounds.description: Demonstrated addiction to, severe dependency on, or habitual overuse of alcohol or other drugs that impairs ability to practice safely
disciplinary_grounds.quote: addiction to, severe dependency on, or habitual overuse of alcohol or other drugs that impairs the licensee's ability to practice safely

disciplinary_grounds.description: Demonstrated unfitness because of physical or mental disability
disciplinary_grounds.quote: unfitness because of physical or mental disability

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaged in unprofessional conduct, sexual misconduct, or lewd or immoral conduct in connection with delivery of professional services to patients
disciplinary_grounds.quote: engaged in unprofessional conduct, in sexual misconduct, or in lewd or immoral conduct in connection with the delivery of professional services to patients

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violated any code of ethics adopted by regulation by the board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: has violated any code of ethics adopted by regulation by the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Denied care or treatment to a patient solely because the patient refused to agree to arbitrate
disciplinary_grounds.quote: has denied care or treatment to a patient or person seeking assistance from the physician if the only reason for the denial is the failure or refusal of the patient to agree to arbitrate

disciplinary_grounds.description: Had a license or certificate to practice medicine in another state/territory/province denied, suspended, revoked, surrendered under investigation, restricted, limited, conditioned, or placed on probation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: has had a license or certificate to practice medicine in another state or territory of the United States, or a province or territory of Canada, denied, suspended, revoked, surrendered while under investigation for an alleged violation, restricted, limited, conditioned, or placed on probation

disciplinary_grounds.description: Prescribed or dispensed an opioid in excess of the maximum dosage authorized under AS 08.64.363
disciplinary_grounds.quote: prescribed or dispensed an opioid in excess of the maximum dosage authorized under AS 08.64.363

definition_quote.value: for a fee, donation or other consideration, to diagnose, treat, operate on, prescribe for, or administer to, any human ailment, blemish, deformity, disease, disfigurement, disorder, injury, or other mental or physical condition; or to attempt to perform or represent that a person is authorized to perform any of the acts set out in this subparagraph
definition_quote.quote: for a fee, donation or other consideration, to diagnose, treat, operate on, prescribe for, or administer to, any human ailment, blemish, deformity, disease, disfigurement, disorder, injury, or other mental or physical condition

methods_authorized.quote: to diagnose, treat, operate on, prescribe for, or administer to, any human ailment, blemish, deformity, disease, disfigurement, disorder, injury, or other mental or physical condition

drug_authority.value: Physicians may prescribe, dispense, and administer prescription drugs including controlled substances, subject to opioid prescribing limits and telehealth rules
drug_authority.quote: A physician, podiatrist, osteopath, or physician assistant licensed under AS 08.64 may prescribe, dispense, or administer through telehealth under this section a prescription for a controlled substance listed in AS 11.71.140 - 11.71.190 if the physician, podiatrist, osteopath, or physician assistant complies with state and federal law governing the prescription, dispensing, or administering of a controlled substance.

license_status_types.quote: a licensee in good standing with the board may apply for the conversion of an active or inactive license to a retired status license

foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.value: Foreign medical graduates must complete three years of postgraduate training (or alternative board-approved proof of competency), meet requirements of AS 08.64.200(a)(3)-(5) and 08.64.255, and pass examinations specified by the board in regulations.
foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.quote: Applicants who are graduates of medical colleges not accredited by the Association of American Medical Colleges and the Council on Medical Education of the American Medical Association shall (1) meet the requirements of AS 08.64.200(a)(3) - (5) and 08.64.255; (2) have successfully completed (A) three years of postgraduate training

postgraduate_training_years_required.quote: two years if the applicant graduated from medical school on or after January 1, 1995

pain_management_education_required.quote: receive education in pain management and opioid use and addiction, unless the applicant has demonstrated to the satisfaction of the board that the applicant does not currently hold a valid federal Drug Enforcement Administration registration number

opioid_prescribing_limits.value: Initial opioid prescription may not exceed a seven-day supply for adult outpatients; prescriptions for minors may not exceed seven days. Exceptions exist for chronic pain, cancer, palliative care, logistical/travel barriers, and substance abuse treatment.
opioid_prescribing_limits.quote: A licensee may not issue (1) an initial prescription for an opioid that exceeds a seven-day supply to an adult patient for outpatient use; (2) a prescription for an opioid that exceeds a seven-day supply to a minor

controlled_substance_database_registrati.quote: require that a licensee who has a federal Drug Enforcement Administration registration number register with the controlled substance prescription database under AS 17.30.200(n)

telehealth_prescribing_rules.value: A physician licensed in AK may prescribe controlled substances via telehealth if complying with state and federal law. A physician licensed in another state may provide telehealth services only for ongoing treatment with an established patient relationship or for life-threatening conditions with a referral from an AK-licensed physician; prescribing controlled substances via telehealth to AK patients by out-of-state physicians is a ground for disciplinary sanction.
telehealth_prescribing_rules.quote: A physician, podiatrist, osteopath, or physician assistant licensed under AS 08.64 may prescribe, dispense, or administer through telehealth under this section a prescription for a controlled substance listed in AS 11.71.140 - 11.71.190 if the physician, podiatrist, osteopath, or physician assistant complies with state and federal law governing the prescription, dispensing, or administering of a controlled substance.

telemedicine_license_available.quote: A physician licensed in another state may provide health care services through telehealth to a patient located in the state as provided in this subsection

physician_assistant_supervision_model.quote: a physician assistant may examine, diagnose, or treat persons under the supervision, control, and responsibility of either a physician licensed under this chapter or a physician exempted from licensing under AS 08.64.370

physician_assistant_prescriptive_authori.value: Physician assistants may prescribe, dispense, or administer controlled substances via telehealth if complying with state and federal law; duties related to pain management and opioid use and addiction may not be delegated to unlicensed agents.
physician_assistant_prescriptive_authori.quote: A physician, podiatrist, osteopath, or physician assistant licensed under AS 08.64 may prescribe, dispense, or administer through telehealth under this section a prescription for a controlled substance listed in AS 11.71.140 - 11.71.190 if the physician, podiatrist, osteopath, or physician assistant complies with state and federal law governing the prescription, dispensing, or administering of a controlled substance.

malpractice_reporting_required.quote: A person licensed under this chapter shall report in writing to the board concerning the outcome of each medical malpractice claim or civil action in which damages have been or are to be paid by or on behalf of the licensee to the claimant or plaintiff, whether by judgment or under a settlement.

hospital_privilege_action_reporting_requ.quote: A hospital that revokes, suspends, conditions, restricts, or refuses to grant hospital privileges to, or imposes a consultation requirement on, a person licensed to practice medicine or osteopathy in the state shall report to the board the name and address of the person and the reasons for the action within seven working days after the action is taken.

impaired_physician_program_authorized.quote: contract with private professional organizations to establish an impaired medical professionals program to identify, confront, evaluate, and treat persons licensed under this chapter who abuse alcohol, other drugs, or other substances or are mentally ill or cognitively impaired

compelled_mental_physical_exam_authority.quote: the board may order a person to whom it has issued a license or permit to submit to a medical or psychiatric examination by a physician or other practitioner of the healing arts appointed by the board

locum_tenens_permit_available.quote: A member of the board, its executive secretary, or a person designated by the board to issue temporary permits may grant a temporary permit to a physician or osteopath for the purpose of (1) substituting for another physician or osteopath licensed in this state

investigational_drug_protection.quote: A physician may not be subject to disciplinary action by the board for prescribing, dispensing, or administering an investigational drug, biological product, or device, or providing related treatment, to a patient for the purpose of sustaining the patient's life if the patient (1) has a terminal illness
